manifest.name: dsh-session-bridge
manifest.description: Session-level multi-thread orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: create ordinary sessions, send queued or interrupt prompts to any session by id, and enumerate sessions. Installs globally, independent of any agent preset.

bundle.text:
# dsh-session-bridge bundle patch
#
# Mounts the session-bridge plugin row in the web profile's HOST plane. Its
# three model-facing tools register globally, so every session — regardless of
# agent preset — can create sessions, send queued/interrupt prompts to any
# session by id, and enumerate sessions.
- insert:
    - id: session-bridge
      name: 'dsh-session-bridge'

readme.text:
Session-level multi-thread orchestration for DeepSeek Harness. Installs as a
bundle in a profile and registers **globally** — every session can use the tools
regardless of agent preset.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `session_create` | Create an ordinary session in the caller's workspace (optional initial prompt); returns the session id. The child binds to the caller's standing composition via `composeFrom` — never re-mounts another preset. |
| `session_send` | Deliver a prompt to any ordinary session by id. `queue` = next-turn FIFO (busy targets finish their turn first); `interrupt` = insert at the next step boundary. Cold sessions resume automatically with their recorded preset mounted. Subagent sessions are refused. |
| `session_list` | Enumerate ordinary sessions (id, title, cwd, running); optional workspace filter. |

From the Git repository (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/FuWenLianggit/dsh-session-bridge
```

Or from a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

Restart the profile (or the desktop app) and hard-refresh the browser. Uninstall
with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-bridge`.

The plugin reads every service structurally through `ctx.get`, so one build
serves both DSH lines:

- **0.2.x (incl. DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2)** — `sessionPersistence.list()` returns
  detached snapshots (`{ header, revision, sizeBytes }`); `session_list` and
  cold-session `session_send` read `snapshot.header`.
- **0.1.7-rc.1 and later 0.1.x** — the same listing returned bare
  `SessionHeader` rows; the normalization in `headerOf()` still accepts them.

Cold resume mounts `header.agentPreset` through `agentPresets.mount()` inside the
`setup` callback. Without that, `agents.resume()` restores history but leaves the
agent without the preset's tools and prompt.

- Send/creation use the harness's built-in session/agent services; the plugin
  only wraps them into model-facing tools.
- Cross-session messages are recorded with `source: { kind: 'session-bridge' }`.
  DSH 0.2 removed the shared `kind: 'plugin'` source kind (each producer declares
  its own), and every consumer falls through an unknown kind to its generic
  rendering.
- Only ordinary sessions are addressable; subagent-owned sessions keep the
  subagent routing fence.
